definitions.data: IFG-APPLE-SPLIT arm SPL, 24 apple-target scenes (16 clear, 8 with the basket-side pillar 'pick_obstacle_crate_post_0_collision'), 600 control rows (15 Hz) x 33 MuJoCo sub-steps (2 ms) per scene. Inputs read only.
definitions.actual_trajectory: physics replay of the recorded client rollout: the run snapshot client (p/hold_w.py reset: pi05_infer.main() scene with the run's episode / seed / obstacle profile, 1000 warm-up mj_steps) then each recorded control row's applied_ctrl for 33 sub-steps (the method of p/replay_contacts.py). fidelity check: qpos_mismatch_rows = control rows whose recorded (measured) qpos differs from the replay pre-step qpos in any element; must be 0 for the scene to be used. Contacts are MuJoCo d.contact of the executed physics, not of the commanded chunk.
definitions.contact: a MuJoCo contact (d.contact entry, exclude == 0) between a robot collision geom (subtree of body 'base') and a non-robot collision geom (contype|conaffinity != 0) with dist <= 0 (penetration >= 0 mm). Secondary threshold: penetration >= 1 mm (dist <= -0.001 m). Entries with dist > 0 (inside the geom margin, not touching) are not contacts; counted separately as 'margin_only'.
definitions.contact_step: a control row (one 15 Hz step, 33 sub-steps) with at least one contact of that (link, partner) class in any of its sub-steps; substeps = number of sub-steps with such a contact.

partner_classes.target: geoms of the manifest target fruit body (apple)
partner_classes.neighbour_fruit: geoms of the other fruit bodies (banana / orange / pear); counted separately from the target
partner_classes.crate: geoms of body 'crate' (basket floor, walls, handles)
partner_classes.pillar: obstacle-manager collision geoms (pick_obstacle_crate_post_0_collision, cylinder r 15 mm, h 180 mm beside the basket)
partner_classes.other: every other non-robot collision geom (floor plane, office walls, shelf)

excluded_by_rule.intended_target_contact: contact between the ACTIVE hand (MuJoCo bodies EE_BODY_<side>, ee_finger_<s>1, ee_finger_<s>2 of manifest episode_used_arm) and the target fruit. Not counted as a collision; its count is reported as 'intended'. Target contacts of any other robot link (inactive hand, wrist, arm) ARE counted (partner 'target').
excluded_by_rule.support_contact: robot bodies base / wheel_l / wheel_r against the floor (partner 'other', body 'world'): wheel support, not counted.

link_classes.checked: the 6 URDF links that carry TrajOpt collision spheres (summary sphere_link_names: ee_left, ee_right, ee_finger_l1, ee_finger_l2, ee_finger_r1, ee_finger_r2; 270 spheres) = MuJoCo bodies EE_BODY_L, EE_BODY_R, ee_finger_l1, ee_finger_l2, ee_finger_r1, ee_finger_r2 (left finger names swapped between MJCF and URDF; the class is body-set based so the swap cannot misclassify)
link_classes.unchecked_wrist: link_<side>_arm_6 and FT_SENSOR_<S> (wrist / flange, no TrajOpt sphere)
link_classes.unchecked_arm: link_<side>_arm_0 .. link_<side>_arm_5 (shoulder, upper arm, elbow, forearm)

definitions.phase: server request k = plan_index of the control row (plan_index = #planning rows with t_step <= t - 1; the chunk executed in that row was planned at request k); phase = summary grasp.state of server chunk k (searching / latched / closing / held / placed).

field_vs_gt.which_contacts: every counted contact row (link, partner geom) pair, at its deepest sub-step in that row (min dist).
field_vs_gt.query_points: p_s = c + s * n_out for s in {0, 5, 10, 20} mm; c = MuJoCo contact position (midway between the two surfaces), n_out = unit contact normal oriented from the partner geom toward the robot geom.
field_vs_gt.field: server constraint record chunk k (the request whose plan was executing), offline `fixed_input_ablation.build_field(z, outside_distance=1.0)`; layers evaluated separately: coarse = layers[0] (20 mm voxel, whole workspace), fine = layers[1] (5 mm voxel window; NaN where the point is outside the window's interpolation box), main = composed min(coarse, fine) = the value unauthorised TrajOpt rows read, free = target-free fine layer (where present). answer_tier = which layer answered main.
field_vs_gt.gt: GT_main(p) = min signed distance over all non-robot collision geoms at the deepest sub-step's MuJoCo state (qpos snapshot), the target left out in 'held' rows where the active hand touches the target in that row (the server frees the held object on purpose); GT_free = same without the target; GT_partner = to the contacted partner body's geoms. Boxes / planes / cylinders analytic, fruit meshes by mj_geomDistance to a 0.1 mm probe sphere (`ifg_audit_lte.Scene`); the runtime pillar (absent from model_transport.xml) analytic from its replay pose.
field_vs_gt.error: field - GT (mm); > 0 = field says farther than reality.
field_vs_gt.layer_gt_pairing: coarse, fine, main vs GT_main; free vs GT_free.

B3_sphere_cover_check.planning_vs_sphere_note: sphere_centres = server FK at refined_chunk[0] (commanded first step); request 0 of ep119 with the robot at rest

notes: definitions were written (script + <out>/definitions_prereg.json) before the 24-scene replay; a one-scene smoke test (ep901) was run first.
replay fidelity: qpos_mismatch_rows = 0 in all 24 scenes (recorded measured qpos == replay pre-step qpos, every element, every control row).
MuJoCo contacts with dist > 0 (margin) were recorded too: margin_only_records per scene in per_scene (all 0 in this data).

B2 field: the request whose chunk was executing (plan_index of the row). The field is built from observations up to that request; the contact happens 0-7 control rows (0-0.47 s) after the request's capture.

B2 GT uses model_transport.xml collision geoms with the deepest sub-step qpos (66) of the replay; the pillar is analytic from its replay pose; fruit meshes are MuJoCo convex hulls (visual-vs-collision geometry differs by up to ~2 mm on fruit surfaces, see IFG-AUDIT-LTE notes).
checked / unchecked body mapping position check: B3_sphere_cover_check (ep119 request 0, fraction of each body's collision points within 5 mm of the recorded TrajOpt spheres).
the scene figure renders model_transport.xml + a visual-only pillar cylinder at the replay pose; the contact marker is drawn in 2D over the render (visible even when occluded).
cross-check vs the kit's replay_contacts.py output (same replay method, classes hand / robot_other): 192 of 192 (scene, class) row counts equal
